title: Founded ICT New Technology Development Company (later Legend
statement: Founded ICT New Technology Development Company (later Legend, then Lenovo) in 1984 using a state-institute investment.

title: Returned to the Lenovo chairmanship in February 2009 during the
statement: Returned to the Lenovo chairmanship in February 2009 during the global financial crisis to steer a turnaround.
outcome: Lenovo achieved a successful turnaround under Liu and Yang Yuanqing, regaining momentum in the PC market and expanding into mobile internet, per Lenovo's own 2011 press release.

title: Retired as Chairman of Legend Holdings in December 2019
statement: Retired as Chairman of Legend Holdings in December 2019, handing the role to CFO Ning Min while retaining honorary chairman, senior adviser, and strategy-committee positions.
outcome: Ning Min succeeded Liu as Legend Holdings chairman in December 2019; Liu remained honorary chairman, senior adviser, and a member of the board's strategy committee, per SCMP's report on the exchange filing.
